directly_defined: Trace-admissibility inheritance is scoped to coherent nesting controls.
The campaign supports inheritance through depth 10 across 64 seeds.
Ablated nesting collapses trace inheritance by depth 10.
inferred_inside_framework: Trace-admissibility can be carried from RT_n to RT_{n+1} when PRIN_001, PRIN_003, residue preservation, non-collapse, and zero-recoupling constraints are preserved.
The recursive engine no longer needs exhaustive re-derivation from RT_core at every depth under those declared controls.
does_not_prove: No unrestricted theorem promotion is made.
No physical recurrence, conservation law, or ontological permanence claim is made.
No bypass of local well-formedness or continuation admissibility checks is licensed.
failure_modes: Residue aliasing or erasure blocks inheritance.
Same-sign or unlawful zero recoupling blocks inheritance.
Using inheritance to bypass local checks invalidates the recursive step.
